Language Movement veteran Azharuddin passes away
2014-05-10T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Barisal
https://www.thedailystar.net/language-movement-veteran-azharuddin-passes-away-23483

AKM Azharuddin, a freedom fighter and a Language Movement veteran, passed away at the capital's Birdem hospital Thursday evening. He was 82. He left behind his three daughters, five sons and a host of admirers to mourn his death. Born at South Alekanda of Barisal city in 1932, Azharuddin participated in the historic movement in 1952 when he was a class X student of the city's AK Institution. As a social worker he founded Kishore Majlish, a juvenile voluntary organisation, in his area in 1953. He was a retired official of Water Development Board. Azharuddin was buried at his family graveyard at Alekanda following a namaz-e-janaza after Juma prayers.
